        Detail Routing
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
User Interface Extensibility
 > Metadata Web Pages
 > Detail Pages
 > Detail Routing
    
    
    
        There is a single Detail controller and single view that interpret metadata and render controls dynamically at runtime for Detail screens. Please see the Metadata Page Architecture topic for more details. The following routes are currently defined for the Detail pages.


    
        
            Name

            Template

            Example

            Description
        

        
            Detail

            Details/{id}/{internalNum}

            localhost/scale/details/workinstruction/10000

            Calls index method of "Detail" controller passing the specified entity name and entity Id for "edit" or "display" mode.
        

        
            Detail

            Details/{id}

            localhost/scale/details/shipmentheader

            Calls index method of "Detail" controller passing the specified entity name for "insert" mode with no parent.
        

        
            DetailWithParent

            Details/{parentid}/{internalNum}/{id}

            localhost/scale/details/shipmentheader/5/shipmentdetail

            Calls index method of "Detail" controller passing the specified parent entity name and Id, along with the child entity name for "insert" mode with an already existing parent.
